Explore Our Research Meet the Group Research Questions that connect scales Scientific areas linked directly to their people, projects and publications. 01 String Theory & Quantum Gravity String dynamics, dualities, higher-derivative corrections and quantum aspects of gravitation. 02 Early-Universe Cosmology Inflation, string cosmology, primordial black holes and high-energy dynamics of the early universe. 03 Quantum Field Theory Quantum fields in equilibrium and nonequilibrium settings, curved backgrounds and effective theories. 04 Black Holes & Gravitation Black-hole information, quantum black holes, gravitation and semiclassical spacetime physics. 05 String Compactifications Calabi–Yau compactification, moduli stabilisation, flux backgrounds and lower-dimensional effective theories. 06 Mathematical Physics Noncommutative geometry, representation theory, deformation quantization and geometric structures in physics.
